neighbours.label: object pronoun right after 'let', 'put', 'leave' or 'set' (let me…, put it…, leave it…), where a complement such as 'alone', 'aside', 'this way' is due; not pronouns after tell/give/show/see
fire: Before you decide, let me explain what happened at the meeting.
If you are too tired to cook, just let me handle dinner tonight.
To be fair, let's put it this way: nobody won.
When the phone rings during lunch, I usually leave it on the desk.
Hold on a second and let me check the timetable.
She folded the letter and put it back in the drawer.
The boy was sulking, so we decided to leave him be for an hour.
Once the cake is done, set it aside to cool.
quiet: Before you decide, ask me what happened at the meeting.
If you are too tired to cook, just tell me and I will order dinner.
To be fair, I saw it coming: nobody won.
When the phone rings during lunch, I usually hear it from the kitchen.
Hold on a second and show me the timetable.
She folded the letter and gave it to her sister.
The boy was sulking, so we decided to buy him an ice cream.
Once the cake is done, I will bring you a slice.

notes: Card: ' me' x19 of the top 32 ('Let me at him', 'let me throw'), 'leave him alone', 'put it this way', 'Put that into', 'leave it at that'; output promotes ' aside', ' alone', ' up'. The - pole (' from', ' at', ' to', ' below' before a level or value) is a different slot. Probes: let me 0.55, put it 0.67, leave it 0.40, set it 0.45, let them 0.33, leave her alone 0.17; told me/gave me 0.02, saw it/showed it 0.00.
